Because of this comprehensive mathematical coding, the slightest distortion of the Quran’s text or physical arrangement is im­ mediately exposed. Simple to Understand Impossible to Imitate For the first time in history we have a scripture with built-in proof of divine authorship—a superhuman mathematical composition. Any reader of this book can easily verify the Quran’s mathematical miracle. The word “God” (Allah) is written in bold capital letters throughout the text.
